evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear (grade 2 injury).
evidence.MCL: The contour of medial collateral ligament is not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear at proximal portion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: There are linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: In favor of split fracture with depression of the lateral articular surface of tibial plateau.
